title: Report Model
description: v1 contract (task M5-T125, directive D-090 Wave 0; derived lane plan docs/lanes/PARALLEL_BUILD_PLAN.md section 5) for what EVERY export renders - PDF, Excel and the report screen (plan docs/PRODUCT_PLAN_CURRENT_2026-09-28.md section 3 step 7, sections 5a, 5c, 9; tasks M1-19, M1-22). It is bound to ONE results document by id and canonical digest (results_ref), so the report matches the screen and the revision. It holds the identification line ('Option B · revision 7 · date', section 9); the sheet list, keyed by sheet so every listed PDF sheet must be present (M1-22) - cover, dimensioned site plan, section, 3D massing, calculation table, floor-by-floor table, add-on comparison, assumptions page, and the optional Buildings-Department-style sheet marked 'Preliminary — not for filing'; the standing notices, shown ONCE on one page and never beside numbers, including the exact floor-area reminder (section 5a item 2); the calculation-table rows with Zoning Resolution sections and sources; and the assumptions. Every figure is read from the results document (or, for site facts, the study at the same revision) by JSON Pointer (reads / reads_from), never typed (section 5c item 5; checks C-4, C-5).

contract_version.description: CLOSED enum of published report_model contract versions. 1.0.0 = M5-T125 initial shape (D-090 Wave 0). New versions are admitted only by an accepted contract task that appends to this enum.

results_ref.description: The one results document this report renders (task M1-19: report bound to a revision).

results_digest.description: canonical-json-1 digest of the results document (common.schema.json digest_sha256).

identification_line.description: The report's one identification line (plan section 9 'Communication').

text.description: Option · revision · date, e.g. 'Option B · revision 7 · 2026-09-30'.

sheets.description: The PDF sheet list (plan section 3 step 7). Keyed by sheet so each listed sheet is present exactly once (task M1-22: 'The PDF contains every listed sheet'); page_order gives the page sequence. A drawing sheet that cannot be drawn is present as not_available with one line naming what is missing (task M1-16).

standing_notices.description: Standing notices live behind the status strip and on ONE page of the report, never repeated beside numbers (plan section 5a item 2; task M1-24).

shown_once.description: Always true: the notices appear on one report page only.

not_dob_approval.description: Not a Buildings Department approval (plan section 5a item 2).

floor_area_reminder.const: Make sure this floor area is available for use. Confirm with the owner or developer that none of it was sold or merged with another lot.
floor_area_reminder.description: The floor-area reminder worded exactly as plan section 5a item 2 requires. No records lookup is made (decision P-2).

zoning_lot_not_verified.const: Based on the lots you selected — the app does not verify the zoning lot
zoning_lot_not_verified.description: The zoning lot is not verified (plan section 3 step 2, section 5a item 2; check C-9).

district_incomplete.description: The district-is-incomplete notice while any output or add-on of the district is not implemented, tested and reviewed (plan sections 5a item 2, 12a 'Honesty rule'); null when the district is complete.

additional.description: Other standing notices, e.g. the condo line (plan section 8) or recorded zoning-lot documents (check C-9).

calculation_rows.description: The calculation table (PDF sheet and Excel file): values, units, sources and Zoning Resolution sections (plan section 3 step 7). A row that cannot be calculated shows 'Not available' and the reason in place of the number.

assumptions.description: Everything on the one assumptions page (plan section 3 step 7; section 9 'Explicit assumptions').

_expected_failure.description: FIXTURE-ONLY annotation stating the intended defect of an invalid fixture (packages/contracts README convention). Producers NEVER emit this key.

pointer_ref.description: Where a figure or table is read from: a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the referenced results document, the study at the referenced revision (e.g. a site fact such as lot area), or this report model itself (e.g. '/assumptions'). Figures are read, never typed (plan section 5c item 5; checks C-4, C-5).

pointer.description: Points at the LEAF value, never at a containing object, so the consistency sweep (checks C-4, C-5) compares values mechanically: e.g. '/answers/floor_area_allowance/values/1/value' or '/site/facts/0/value'. Tables and drawings (reads_from) point at the array or object they are drawn from.

cover_sheet.description: Cover sheet: address, zone, lots, floor-area allowance, maximum height (plan section 3 step 7).

reads_from.description: Pointers the drawing is drawn from (the results geometry block and the values it labels).

measurement_note.description: Note on the drawing when measurements are not from a survey, e.g. 'Approximate — city tax map, not a survey' (plan section 3 step 7); null for survey measurements.

reason.description: One line naming what is missing (task M1-16).

reads_from.description: Pointers the table is filled from.

preliminary_sheet.description: Optional sheet styled like the Buildings Department zoning diagram (plan section 3 step 7).

zr_section.description: The Zoning Resolution section behind the value; null for a site fact such as lot area (its source is in 'source').

source.description: Source in words with dataset and version where applicable, e.g. 'City records — PLUTO 26v2' or 'Rule table r6b-far 0.1.0 (draft)'.
